profile.reading: This T5 Data Centers facility, T5 Chicago II, is located in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, in the Chicago metro area. T5 Data Centers is a data center developer and owner operating for nearly 2 decades, licensed as a general contractor in 48 states, with 22 data centers developed and more than 4 million square feet of data center space and 3 plus gigawatts of managed capacity across its portfolio as of the operator own most recent public figures. No facility specific address, square footage, or MW capacity for this Chicago area building is published in sourcing reachable this session. A recent corporate restructuring, described on T5's own homepage, moved T5 Services' operations under Salute, a separate company, while T5 Services' construction arm launched independently as EverOn Data Center Services; this registry notes the change without attributing it to any specific building-level fact about this Chicago-area facility. This entry's address is derived from reverse-geocoding this record's own OpenStreetMap coordinates to the Elk Grove Technology Park in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, part of the broader O'Hare-adjacent Chicago-area data center corridor that has drawn colocation and enterprise demand for its proximity to the airport, fiber density, and access to ComEd power infrastructure; the specific street address was not confirmed on any T5 page reachable this session, since T5's locations pages load facility listings via client-side JavaScript that a direct fetch cannot render. No facility-specific square footage or MW capacity for this Chicago-area building was located in sourcing reachable this session. This registry treats the reverse-geocoded location as an approximation of the park the building sits within rather than an operator-confirmed street address, and would update it if a future session locates a working, JavaScript-rendered version of T5's own Chicago facility page.

reading.body:
T5 Chicago II's actual power capacity cannot be determined because the operator publishes no facility-specific figures and the facility page is no longer accessible.

T5 Data Centers operates 22 facilities totaling over 3 gigawatts nationwide, but this Chicago-area campus discloses neither capacity nor square footage. Illinois has 44 mapped data centers, yet only 6 publish power figures. The 236 megawatts of disclosed capacity in the state comes from those six facilities. T5 Chicago II's published capacity either equals zero or falls below the minimum disclosed figure statewide, placing it seventh or lower in the state by whatever power it may hold.

This creates a gap between operator scale and facility transparency. A developer managing 3-plus gigawatts across multiple states has both the capital and expertise to build substantial infrastructure, but investors and researchers cannot verify this particular site's contribution to regional compute or power demand without disclosed specifications.

The facility cannot be assessed as material to AI infrastructure scaling until the operator publishes power delivery, cooling capability, or footprint. The inaccessible facility page suggests either recent changes in the operator's web presence or that this project remains unpublished in its specifications. Illinois data center capacity remains partially invisible.
